Ombrelle: 2 directions

Make me a font like Seurat's A Sunday Afternoon on the Island of La Grande Jatte. Build every letter from small dots of pure color, with a sunny side and a violet shadow side. It follows Georges Seurat and Paul Signac, above all Seurat's "A Sunday Afternoon on the Island of La Grande Jatte". The letters are painted the way they painted: small separate dots of pure color that mix in the eye. An ombrelle is the sun parasol that the people in that painting carry. - **What is it for?** Titles, posters and labels, from about 40 px up. Not for running text. (I chose this.) - **What should it feel like?** Sunny, calm and solid: a letter is a thing standing in afternoon light. (I chose this.) - **What must it not look like?** Confetti: a flat fill of random dots. Also not a halftone screen or a grid. (I chose this.) - **Which styles?** One style in each family, with three palettes: Afternoon, Harbor and Circus. A color font has no variable file. (I chose this.)
